body: I gave you approval for all of the items I sent to you
title: PAR-001 to PAR-009 agreed on the developer's approval of the parity program
wrong_if: the developer's approval did not cover the application port's requests (#125 to #129) or the queue fake gaps

body: Handle-bound: tx.after_commit and a with_tx job dispatch defer to the handle's commit; DB::after_commit follows the ambient DB::transaction Instead: Escalate to reword PAR-007 so it names only the ambient DB::transaction
rests_on: DB::begin_transaction returns a handle and sets no ambient state: ambient writes never join it, only _with_tx calls do, so ambient code is outside that transaction; a per-connection or per-task lookup would mix concurrent requests (one pool) or fail in root futures where tokio try_id is None
title: How does PAR-007 apply to a transaction started with DB::begin_transaction, which nothing ambient can see?
wrong_if: A port that calls DB::after_commit between DB::begin_transaction and commit sees its callback run at once and must switch to tx.after_commit

subject: PAR-001 to PAR-009 built and passing on the merged tree. The quoted 11:27 words were over-read as the whole brief; the developer narrowed the approval at 14:32, and kept #125 to #129 at 14:37 ("let's get these issues done"); the queue fake gaps (PAR-009) were among the recommendations accepted on 2026-09-30.

Built as decided: DB::after_commit follows the ambient DB::transaction; a DB::begin_transaction handle takes tx.after_commit and Queue::push_after_commit_with_tx; after_commit_callback tests pass (PAR-007).

subject: Built as decided: a manifest declares no crates (library.rs refuses any key outside the closed set, cargoDependencies included; reg_002_a_manifest_with_a_key_outside_the_set_is_refused) and the Rust scan admits only the documented Suprnova API, the component's own items, its dependencies' modules and the effect-free part of std (scan/rust, scan/allowlist.jsonl; reg_030_* and the rust-* bypass corpus). live:add never changes Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock (reg_006_live_add_never_changes_cargo_toml_or_cargo_lock).

Built as decided: the first install pins the library's key on a terminal and --yes pins nothing (reg_024_a_new_key_is_pinned_only_on_a_terminal); a key change is accepted only with a handover statement signed by the pinned key, re-pinned on a terminal, and live:registry rotate-key writes those statements (reg_033_*); re-exported crates are admitted through suprnova:: paths only, each with its capability (scan/allowlist.jsonl prefix entries; reg_030_dependency_modules_are_admitted_and_other_components_are_not).

Built as decided: live:check verifies every recorded component offline (reg_027_*); with no @version live:add takes the highest v<semver> release tag (reg_026_no_version_takes_the_highest_release); a view URL must be a constant on the application's origin or a value from the application or a capability-free helper (scan/view url checks; view-* bypass corpus).

Built as decided: the SDK follows docs/spec/component-registries.md with Askama views parsed by askama_parser (scan/view) and nothing from the stopped suprnova-live-components-sdk attempt; the scaffold's example component renders through the application's Askama templates (reg_005_reg_021_a_signed_library_installs_compiles_and_renders_in_a_scaffolded_application).

subject: Built as decided: a primitive #[authorize] target checks its path value (suprnova-macros/src/handler.rs; handler::tests::bind_015_a_primitive_authorize_target_checks_the_path_value, bind_015_an_authorize_target_must_bind_or_be_a_path_value); the ResourceController trait still routes beside the function form resource!/api_resource! (framework/tests/routing/route_binding/resources.rs bind_011_a_resource_controller_routes_as_it_did, bind_011_a_function_resource_action_receives_a_bound_model); a primitive argument the path does not declare is refused at startup (bind_013_a_primitive_for_an_undeclared_parameter_is_refused, startup.rs:229). route-binding receipt f79615e9 passes at a52358b8a.

Built as decided: Suprnova's tables are upgraded in place on a Laravel database and resumable (ldb_010_an_interrupted_upgrade_resumes_*), Laravel-created tables and rows are left as Laravel left them, on migrate and on rollback (ldb_011_migrations_leave_laravels_tables_as_laravel_left_them_*, ldb_011_a_rollback_leaves_laravels_tables_and_rows_*), $2b$ and the Argon2id upgrade stay the default and LARAVEL_SHARED_DATABASE writes and rewrites $2y$, failing a sign-in whose rewrite cannot be stored (ldb_004_by_default_hashes_are_2b_and_magnetar_upgrades_to_argon2id, ldb_004_with_hash_verify_an_argon2id_user_signs_in_and_is_rewritten_*, ldb_004_with_the_setting_a_sign_in_whose_rewrite_cannot_be_stored_fails_*), remember_token is left intact (ldb_007_magnetar_sign_ins_leave_remember_token_*), and Laravel's first-party package tables and spatie/laravel-permission are covered (ldb_001_queue_session_and_notification_stores_work_on_laravels_tables_*, ldb_008_pennant_flags_read_and_write_*, ldb_008_spatie_roles_and_permissions_*), on SQLite, Postgres and MySQL. laravel-database receipt 7c18ea8f passes at a52358b8a.

Built as decided: RDOC's root template is not built here and none of its requirements is in this commitment, so it waits for the security-headers commitment with its nonce source; MEM-003's Agreed text carries the narrow exceptions (the IMG-001, IMG-002 and IMG-006 image changes, output at a public root other than /, a Vite tag whose assets_base_url attribute escaping changes, the LDB-002 failed-job payload, and built-in driver JPEGs as JFIF YCbCr), and mem_audit_image_output_is_byte_for_byte_what_it_was holds every other image digest; REG-031 admits url::root() before a rooted constant path and nothing else before it (reg_031_url_root_before_a_rooted_constant_path_is_admitted, reg_031_url_root_before_anything_but_a_rooted_constant_is_refused, reg_031_url_root_is_admitted_and_carries_no_capability); REG-032 is not in this commitment, so relative imports wait for the third. mem-footprint receipt c1a9994f and registries-scan receipt 324bbc0a pass at a52358b8a.

Built as decided: url::root() is the accessor for views and components (pfx_011_url_root_returns_the_root_without_a_trailing_slash, pfx_011_url_root_carries_no_capability_in_the_allowlist); the scaffold's pages build every URL from the root (pfx_012_root_share_gives_every_page_the_root, pfx_012_scaffold_pages_build_every_url_from_the_root_prop); the first of two same-named cookies wins (pfx_013_parse_cookies_keeps_the_first_cookie_of_a_name, pfx_013_every_framework_cookie_reads_the_first_of_a_name); a repeated X-Forwarded-Prefix is ignored whole (pfx_001_a_prefix_sent_on_two_lines_is_ignored_whole); a trusted / makes the root the host root (pfx_001_a_trusted_slash_makes_the_root_the_host_root); url::current returns root, path and query, read by the pfx_002 tests in framework/tests/path_prefix/root.rs. path-prefix receipt c51642da passes at a52358b8a.

Built as decided: there is no store_publicly, since visibility belongs to the disk (framework/src/media/mod.rs, manual/images.md); a custom ImageMagick step gets decoded pixels and adds no argument and no file (img_004_a_magick_custom_step_adds_no_argument_and_no_file, img_004_a_custom_step_runs_at_its_place_under_magick); output keeps no EXIF, XMP, IPTC or text metadata under either driver (img_002_magick_output_keeps_no_exif_xmp_iptc_or_text, img_002_oxideav_output_keeps_no_exif_xmp_iptc_or_text); the images mechanism needs the host ImageMagick 7 and fails without it (scripts/check-images.sh). images receipt c5083b12 passes at a52358b8a.
